summary: Iteration 22: Tested admin suspend/restore, role templates, RBAC, and Admin page UI. All 13 backend pytest cases passed (100%). Frontend Admin page renders correctly with proper testids after a small fix to ui-kit (Badge/Card now forward props). Suspend/Restore toggle flow verified end-to-end via UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Did not forward props/data-testid to DOM element, so user-status-{id} and role-card-{role} testids were missing from HTML (though present in JSX). FIXED by spreading ...props onto span/div.

action_items: None blocking. UI-kit prop-forwarding fix already applied by tester.
Consider auditing other ui-kit primitives (Btn already forwards, Empty likely doesn't) to consistently forward props for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: ui-kit Badge/Card previously silently dropped data-testid/aria props — this hurts testability across the app. Fixed by adding ...props spread. Same pattern should be applied wherever a component is used as a wrapper.
auth.py set_user_active correctly enforces self and admin-role safeguards and returns updated user with recomputed allowed_tabs. Good.
get_current_user rejects active=False with 403; existing JWTs immediately invalidated on suspension. Confirmed.
role-templates PUT correctly bulk-updates existing users when apply_to_existing=true, and register/invite paths inherit via resolve_role_tabs. Good.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway nurse users (TEST_*) created via register and deleted at end of tests. role_templates.nurse doc created during apply_to_existing test and deleted afterwards; allowed_tabs $unset on seeded nurse@vpp.com so it reverts to code defaults. Verified via mongo cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/users/{id}/active, /api/role-templates, /api/role-templates/{role}, /api/meta/tabs all working with proper RBAC and safeguards. Frontend Admin page (Team.js) fully functional: Status column, toggle-active button with confirm dialog, Role Access cards with template modal (14 tabs, apply-to-existing checkbox, save button). NOTE: I applied a fix to Badge & Card components in ui-kit.js so they forward props (data-testid). If other primitives (Empty, etc.) show missing testids, apply the same ...props spread pattern.
